name: network.route_quotas

get.description: Read all dynamic and static quotas for one route, account and tenant context.

parameters.name: account-alias
parameters.description: Exact nonblank native account alias; ANY is forbidden.

lookup.name: routeId
lookup.description: Exact nonblank native route reference; ANY is forbidden.

result_identity.description: Request-context composite primary key (routeId, aliasName, tntInstId); absent native echoes are not fabricated.

purpose: Inspect complete native dynamic and static quota arrays for an explicitly identified route, account and tenant.

fields.name: dynamicQuotas
fields.meaning: Native dynamic quota objects, with order, duplicates and numeric precision preserved.

fields.name: staticQuotas
fields.meaning: Native static quota objects, including blank quotaId and nested time configurations.

identity_description: Get-only aggregate identified by the routeId, aliasName and tntInstId request context; no inferred quota member identity.
limitations: GET /queryWhaleRouteDetail.json on iliquidity.alipay.com; exact routeId and aliasName, fixed tntInstId GUAPW3SG. No ANY or unbounded query.
Return the complete native result.data object. Both quota arrays are required arrays of objects; unknown fields, nested values, order and duplicate members remain native.

The composite key belongs to the request context. Native context echoes may be missing or empty; any nonempty echo must match the request. Request parameters are metadata, never injected into native output.
result.count is not quota coverage or member identity. Blank or duplicate quotaId is preserved. No List, refresh, cache publication, Duckdog import or modification.

examples.title: Read one account route aggregate
examples.command: dogopencli liquidity get network.route_quotas ROUTE --account-alias ACCOUNT
